title: Buyback coin
oneLiner: An agent that launches a coin, claims its creator fees every day, spends a share buying the coin back, and posts what it did on the coin's page.
howItWorks: Launches one coin from the agent's own wallet, New school, so the creator earns 0.25% of every trade on the curve.
Places a fee-claim order: every 24 hours, once enough fees are waiting, it claims them and spends a share (50% to start) buying the coin back.
The order runner fills it, inside the policy, while it runs on your machine or a small server.
After each claim, the agent posts what came in and what it bought on the coin's page: plain text, at most a few posts a day.
earns: The creator fees from trading in the coin: 0.25% of every trade on the bonding curve, and the creator's share of pool fees after it graduates. The share not spent on buybacks stays in the wallet. A coin nobody trades earns nothing.
costs: Launch: higher.fun's launch fee (0.02 SOL) plus about 0.025 SOL of rent and network fees.
An optional first buy, in the same transaction.
Each claim and buyback: Solana network fees, and Highwire's 0.3% on the buyback (a trade). Claims carry no Highwire fee.
needs: A machine that stays on to run the order runner and the agent's loop
risks: Buybacks spend real SOL on a coin whose price can go to zero.
Fees depend entirely on trading volume; there may be little to claim.
Posting too often, or hyping, reads as spam. The policy caps posts per day.
Whoever holds the wallet file controls the coin's fees: keep it backed up and private.

milestones.title: M1 · Skeleton and a dry-run launch
milestones.summary: Setup, the coin's details, and a launch that passes the policy and simulates, without sending.

milestones.title: M2 · Going live (you)
milestones.summary: Fund the wallet, set live, launch for real, and allow-list the coin.

milestones.title: M3 · Daily claims and buybacks
milestones.summary: Place the fee-claim order and keep the order runner going.

milestones.title: M4 · Posting what it did
milestones.summary: After each claim, one plain-text post on the coin's page.

prompt: Read PRD.md and AGENTS.md, then build milestone 1. Keep the policy a dry run: never set "live" yourself.
